title: [E16-10] Observable Background Jobs and Analytics ETL
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-10 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a engineer, I want to prepare scalable job queues and analytics ETL, so I can support growth.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Infrastructure  
**Priority:** P2  
**Target Release:** D — Commercial growth — after pilot evidence  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** Expanded product scope; no PDF story mapping  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P2`, `release:D`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E16-06](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/75), [E16-07](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/76), [E13-02](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/173)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E16-06, E16-07, E13-02.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Asynchronous processing is observable, retryable and does not affect core ledger.
- [ ] Introduce queues only for justified asynchronous workloads.
- [ ] Version event contracts and support bounded retries, dead-letter inspection and replay.
- [ ] Make analytics rebuildable from authoritative sources without writing ledger balances.
- [ ] Enforce purpose/tenant scopes and expose lag/failure metrics.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Use transactional outbox ingestion and idempotent jobs; do not feed monitoring data into commercial analytics.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Replay/backfill a job batch with transient failures and verify stable aggregates, no duplicate notifications and unchanged ledgers.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.
